recognize_zh: kappa 輕鏈原位雜交（ISH）染色的骨髓組織中，可見大量散在或小群聚、細胞質呈深藍黑色訊號的陽性漿細胞，數量明顯多於同一檢體 lambda ISH 的少數陽性細胞——表示 kappa 輕鏈限制的單株漿細胞族群。
features: Bone marrow tissue with fat spaces and a hemorrhagic eosinophilic background
Numerous cells with dark blue-black cytoplasmic kappa ISH signal
Positive cells distributed singly and in small clusters throughout the field
Positive cells show a perinuclear cytoplasmic rim of signal consistent with plasma cells
Low image resolution limits detailed cytology
describe_en: In situ hybridization for kappa light-chain mRNA on a bone marrow section shows numerous positive cells with dark cytoplasmic signal, present singly and in small clusters among fat spaces and a hemorrhagic background. Compared with the lambda ISH on the same specimen, which marks only rare cells, there is a marked excess of kappa-positive plasma cells. Image resolution limits cytologic detail. Findings indicate a kappa light-chain-restricted clonal plasma cell population, supporting lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the appropriate morphologic and clinical context.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are a mixture with a kappa-to-lambda ratio of about 1-3:1, whereas this case shows marked kappa predominance.
Myeloma shows light-chain restriction with sheets of often atypical plasma cells, CD56 or cyclin D1 expression and no clonal small B-cell component.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Restriction is shared, and separation depends on IgM paraprotein, marrow pattern and MYD88 L265P rather than the ISH itself.
True ISH signal is crisp, cytoplasmic and cell-associated, whereas background artifact is diffuse and also overlies red cells and stroma.
